sources.title: README.md · Ishowbackup/Qwen3.8-27B-ABLITERATED-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is the dense, deployment-friendly member of the Qwen3.8 family. This is the abliterated Blackfrost build: refusal behavior was reduced through a weight-level process, then the BF16 parent was converted into a standard GGUF ladder for local llama.cpp inference.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.
